status: Reviewable design prototype; backend APIs and execution remain specified, not implemented by this artifact

reference_evidence.observed: Two-column IRIS intent builder. Left rail selects Collateral, Debt, Maturity, Max Rate and Venue; the right panel edits the current choice. Debt shows asset, amount and LTV slider. Maximum-rate view shows an exact input plus Tight/Mid/Wide choices.
keep: Full context remains visible while a field is edited
adapt: Nest forest/cream/orange and IBM Plex families
Horizon replaces universal Maturity; actual term/maturity is market-capability dependent
Blend, Templar and XOXNO compared at identical inputs
Presets are illustrative until generated from verified current quotes

reference_evidence.observed: Position management includes venue-sourced health, adding collateral, withdrawing permitted excess collateral and repayment/close-out. IRIS describes venue-specific liquidation boundaries and separate fixed-term/solver behavior.
keep: Withdraw excess collateral only when valid
Repay and close with explicit cost and collateral-release preview
do_not_generalize: A universal health-factor threshold for incompatible venue metrics
Full-term fixed interest for all Nest loans
IRIS maturity and grace rules on markets that do not expose them

reference_evidence.observed: IRIS documents Active, Grace period and Liquidatable phases; quote-bound overdue rates/grace periods and fixed-term early-close interest. These inform a conditional term-loan panel, not generic assumptions about Nest venues.

theme.logo: Original woven Nest with plain circular egg
theme.display: IBM Plex Serif 600 for page/section titles
theme.data: IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals
theme.status: Independent semantic colors with text and symbols

screens.purpose: Capture a complete borrowing intent and compare integrated venues at the same collateral, debt, horizon and constraints.

layout.page_header: Credit label, serif title, concise purpose and contextual Ask Nest action
layout.desktop: Centered two-panel builder with maximum combined width 1180px and 24px gap. Left term rail / right editor use 1.15fr / 0.85fr. The comparison table retains the workspace width.
layout.term_rail: Five 68px selection controls, 12px radius, active orange outline; selected values remain visible. Compare and Reset follow the rail.
layout.editor: Minimum 540px desktop study, 24px padding. Field-specific asset identity, amount and explanatory content. Apply action at the bottom.
layout.comparison: Dense table preserving all three venue results and exclusion reasons. Numeric values right aligned, provenance/assumptions below.
layout.mobile: Below 801px of workspace, stack the term rail and editor with a maximum width of 640px. Comparison retains contained horizontal scrolling.

fields.label: Collateral
fields.validation: Positive decimal, registry-resolved canonical asset, account balance/reserves/capacity at preparation. No silent asset substitution.

fields.label: Debt
content: Native initial LTV derived from adapter terms
fields.validation: Do not reduce requested debt to make a venue fit. Exclude unsupported pairs, insufficient capacity and invalid health separately.

fields.label: Horizon
content: Rate type and actual maturity if supported
fields.validation: A comparison horizon does not promise a fixed rate, fixed maturity or guaranteed exit.

fields.label: Max rate
fields.type: Decimal APR ceiling / normalized strict constraint
fields.validation: Preserve APR/APY semantics. Editing this form does not write saved Guardrails.

fields.label: Venue
fields.validation: Eligibility is specific to account, network, asset, market and current capability, not protocol name alone.

comparison_columns: Estimated horizon interest and cost methodology
Initial LTV, maximum initial LTV and liquidation parameters
Observation time, expiry and execution availability
Review terms action or explicit exclusion reason
interaction: Selecting a term focuses the corresponding right editor without dropping the other selected terms.
A field-specific Apply validates its draft and updates the intent. Invalid text remains visible with an inline error and cannot poison the last valid comparison.
Changing any applied input invalidates the old executable quote set. A real implementation immediately disables stale Review actions while recomputing.
Compare venues requests a bounded concurrent quote set for the exact inputs. Timeouts and exclusions remain visible.
Picking a venue result creates a typed proposal; it does not sign or submit.
Supply opportunities navigate to the direct-supply/vault discovery view rather than changing a borrow into a supply silently.
Reset clears only the local form/comparison draft; it does not alter saved policy or positions.
screens.prototype_behavior: All financial values are explicit fixtures. Local rate/amount editing recalculates illustrative interest/capacity and native-risk displays only; no wallet/API/model calls are made. JavaScript Number is used only for fixture presentation. Real financial math must use exact raw-unit/fixed-point services.

states.initial: Editable terms and comparison explanation before wallet connection
states.validating: Inline field errors; preserve draft and last valid comparison
states.loading: Skeleton result rows and bounded progress; no previous quote remains actionable
states.partial: Successful venues retained, unavailable venues show reasons and observed coverage
states.no_eligible_venue: Explain capacity/pair/constraint failures; offer explicit input changes
states.quote_expired: Disable review and request a new revision
states.wallet_required: Allow research comparison; connect and verify wallet before preparing a real plan
states.network_or_wallet_change: Invalidate old prepared review and load new account/network context
states.provider_failure: Manual form remains available; show retry or partial coverage

acceptance: The five intent terms stay visible while any editor is open.
Guest users can compare without supplying a fabricated account ID.
Blend, Templar and XOXNO use identical requested collateral/debt/horizon inputs.
Insufficient capacity produces an exclusion instead of silently changing debt.
Rates, fees, horizon assumptions, source timestamps and exit conditions are explicit.
No common health number is invented across incompatible native metrics.
Review uses the shared immutable-plan review with Guardrails revision and deposit withdrawal timing.

screens.purpose: Monitor lending positions and execute supported collateral, repayment and exit actions with venue-native validity and clear settlement state.

layout.summary: Four metrics: confirmed collateral, outstanding debt, net credit value and separately tracked pending workflows, with valuation time.
layout.desktop: Flexible left content for open positions, selected-position health and details; 340px sticky action ticket right.
layout.position_table: Venue/market/account identity, collateral, debt, native risk, Manage action. Keep account IDs separate from wallet and market IDs.
layout.health_panel: Selected venue-native metric, liquidation boundary, valuation/debt/rate facts, actual maturity where supported, source/as-of time. Never present configured warnings as chain validity boundaries.
layout.ticket: Add collateral, withdraw collateral, repay, repay & close. Amount, before/after deltas, resulting native risk, withdrawal timing for additions, eligibility reason and shared-review action.
layout.below: Pending external workflow timeline, conditional term/close-out details and activity/receipt history.
layout.responsive: Below 1100px in the specimen (1024px production baseline), ticket stacks under context; below 768px metrics become 2 columns and timelines wrap in order.

management_actions.rules: Check ownership, asset/network identity, balance/reserves, market capability and post-action health. Show that collateral release remains conditional on debt, health and liquidity.

Disable when liquidatable or a venue/grace restriction applies, or when the projected action breaches chain/venue validity. Available amount comes from the adapter; a generic Max cannot introduce an unsupported withdraw-all sentinel.
Support partial repayment only where the market supports it. Adapter determines exact rounding and close-out behavior.

management_actions.intent_kind: repay followed by supported collateral release steps
management_actions.rules: A generic positive repayment must not silently become repay-all. Full close and collateral release may require multiple separately reviewed steps. Do not assume early repayment reduces term interest, nor assume full-term interest without market evidence.

capability_conditional_facts.Blend: Use pool-native accounting and risk/receipt conversions. No backstop or recursive leverage in P0.
capability_conditional_facts.XOXNO: Bind wallet, NFT-backed lending account, spoke, hub and market IDs separately. Reverify current account ownership before prepare and submit. No P0 migration, NFT transfer, flash loan or looping.
capability_conditional_facts.Templar: Preserve Stellar-origin funding, protocol authorization, external settlement and debt delivery as distinct receipts. Funding confirmation does not mean borrowing completed. Queued supply withdrawals have actual request/queue/execution/cancellation states.
capability_conditional_facts.term_market: Only when returned by the adapter: fixed/floating type, maturity, overdue rate, grace end, liquidation phase, full-term interest/early-close rule and settlement/repayment state. IRIS reference values do not supply Nest terms.

states.healthy: Show native metric and actual venue boundary; provide supported actions
states.warning: Show an accepted policy warning independently of any blocking minimum; require fresh preview
states.liquidatable: Withdrawal disabled with reason; surface supported add-collateral and repay/exit paths
states.matured_or_grace: Only for supported terms; show exact deadlines/costs and permitted actions
states.pending_signature: Keep reviewed exact changes visible; stale/mutated response rejected
states.submitted_reconciling: Show receipt/hash and progress without claiming success
states.partial_completion: Retain completed effects and remaining exposure; new review for a permitted recovery action
states.confirmed: Display actual token/debt/collateral effects and refresh positions
states.no_positions: Explain wallet/ownership requirements and link Borrow/Supply without fabricated balances
states.stale_position: Show last observation and disable execution until refreshed

acceptance: Confirmed collateral, liabilities and net value use one valuation time and do not count receipts plus backing twice.
Pending funding/workflows are tracked separately from confirmed borrowed assets and collateral totals.
Every position exposes supported exit actions and explicit unavailable reasons.
Liquidatable and unsafe post-action withdrawals cannot reach signing.
Collateral additions show withdrawal duration/restrictions before approval.
Repay and close display actual venue costs rather than assuming IRIS mechanics.
A Templar funding receipt cannot mark borrowing complete.
XOXNO ownership, native amount semantics and protocol IDs are revalidated.
Every action uses the same prepared-plan review, expiry/policy binding and confirmed receipt reconciliation.

backend_bindings.status: Existing technical specification defines these contracts. The UI artifact does not prove deployed services or completed adapters.

markets.purpose: Registered assets/markets, native risk parameters, current capabilities and availability; resolve canonical identities and supported lifecycle.

comparison.purpose: Strict amount/asset/horizon/constraint intent and amount-aware quote set with eligible/excluded venues, observations, costs, validity, risk and exit facts.

portfolio.purpose: Owned positions, native IDs, collateral/debt amounts, valuation/freshness, supported actions and pending workflow receipts.

planning.purpose: Immutable revision, exact raw-unit bounds, nested authorization/payload inspection, simulation scope, policy/registry/account versions, withdrawal timing, maximum fees and expiry.

approval_submission.purpose: Explicit revision/digest-bound review and wallet signature; durable claim and signed-payload validation. No independent credit-specific signing path.

events.purpose: Reconnectable persisted execution events and confirmed effects; submitted, reconciling and partially complete remain distinct.

policy.purpose: Read accepted Guardrails and effective requirements. The form cannot silently save policy; explicit global drawer save creates the version.

required_review_fields: displayed fee maxima by charged asset
saved policy revision and warning facts
withdrawal timing for every deposit leg

accessibility: Term selections are native buttons with aria-pressed and a named target editor; keyboard order follows visual order.
Every amount, asset and range control has an accessible name plus unit; errors are associated and announced.
44px targets, visible focus and readable subdued labels; no status relies on color alone.
Comparison and position tables use header scopes, right-aligned financial values and contained overflow on narrow screens.
Review and assistant modal focus are supplied by the shared shell with focus restoration.
State changes announce summaries without announcing every slider tick; reduced motion disables smooth scrolling.

open_decisions.issue: Product requires comparison before wallet connection, while the current typed borrow Intent requires accountId and comparison is specified through POST /api/intents.
open_decisions.required_resolution: Target interface contract; see the application README for implemented capabilities.

open_decisions.issue: Each adapter must supply metric ID, direction, units and threshold semantics; there is no universal health-factor conversion.
open_decisions.required_resolution: Bind selected-position visualization and Guardrails warnings to the actual native-risk schema.

open_decisions.issue: IRIS fixed-term/solver mechanics are reference behavior, not verified Nest venue capabilities.
open_decisions.required_resolution: Render maturity, grace, overdue and early-close terms only from registered adapter results.
